state:
- The CDK5–NUP98 nomination rests on unverified priors, with no defined phosphosite or prior-work comparison. Add a supported selection rationale and literature comparison to substantiate originality and sharpen the displacement mechanism.
- Targeted CDK5 recruitment is not NUP98-specific sufficiency: neighboring pore substrates could contribute despite phospho-null resistance. Verify equivalent recruitment and local kinase activity, and add an orthogonal NUP98-specific phosphorylation or reconstitution experiment.
- Restoring nuclear TDP-43 at fixed total abundance also reduces cytoplasmic TDP-43, confounding nuclear-function rescue with reduced cytoplasmic toxicity. Include matched cytoplasmic-depletion controls and a nuclear-function rescue that preserves cytoplasmic TDP-43 and assembly burden.
